title: Takes
subtitle: Quiet on the tiny set.
description: Direct two opinionated model actors in a handmade 3D theater. Block an original little film, choose lenses and camera angles, and earn six honest shots through real framing, sightlines and continuity before the film runs out.
medium: Miniature theater, bounded AI ensemble and geometric filmmaking
instruction: Open a production brief, rehearse with your configured model, then frame and record a wide and portrait in each scene. Ten film exposures; six shots to keep.
